rows.summary: Fix greet() to return 'hello ' instead of 'helo ' so the test in apps/web/tests/greeter.test.js passes.
Fix the off-by-one error in sumTo by changing the loop condition from i < n to i <= n so it sums up to and including n.
Fix add function to return sum instead of difference.
Change isAdult to return true for age 18 by using >= instead of >.
Add missing return sum; so total([1,2,3]) returns 6 instead of undefined.
Change default tax rate from 20% to 25% so withTax(100) returns 125.
Make sameName ignore case by lowercasing both arguments before comparing.
Fix last() to return the actual last element instead of undefined (off-by-one in index).
Fix ratio to call divide(x, y) instead of divide(y, x) so ratio(10,4) returns 2.5 as expected.
Fix capitalize to slice from index 1 instead of 2, so it returns 'Hello' for 'hello' instead of 'Hllo'.
